description: This Kotlin source file implements an in-memory fallback version of a Room database for a mobile app, providing in-memory DAO implementations for profiles, connections, and transfer history, used when the actual database is unavailable.

classes.name: InMemoryAppDatabase
classes.description: A singleton object providing in-memory DAO implementations and database configuration as a fallback when Room's generated implementation is unavailable.

classes.name: InMemoryConnectionDao
classes.description: In-memory implementation of ConnectionDao, managing connection entities with in-memory state flow.

classes.name: InMemoryTransferHistoryDao
classes.description: In-memory implementation of TransferHistoryDao, managing transfer history entities with in-memory state flow.

methods.name: createInvalidationTracker
methods.description: Creates a no-op InvalidationTracker for in-memory fallback.

methods.name: createOpenHelper
methods.description: Creates a no-op SupportSQLiteOpenHelper for in-memory fallback.

methods.name: clearAllTables
methods.description: Clears all in-memory tables: profiles, connections, transfer history.
